source.version: Part 12 — Trichomes and Cannabinoid Biosynthesis — Batch 01
source.publicationAuthorization: Project owner authorized continued website publication on 2026-08-29. Independent specialist approval remains a separate project-control field and is not implied by publication.
source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-221–225 were reconciled against the controlled Volume 12 manuscript and direct trichome-development, microscopy, cell-wall, metabolite-localization, and cannabinoid-synthase localization literature. Public wording separates morphology from chemistry, treats sessile-to-stalked development as tissue-dependent, and does not use gland size, density, or color as a potency assay.
source.note: This batch opens Volume 12 with the cellular and anatomical foundation needed before cannabinoid biosynthetic pathways are introduced.
